title: Plan a bounded XueMai repository maintenance change
body: Only reviewers may authorize this repository maintenance request. The default time range is 7 days and the maximum time range is 30 days. Limit processing to 100 records. Output fields include file path, finding, and recommendation; redact secrets and personal data. Small requests run synchronously and large requests run asynchronously. Produce a read-only evidence-grounded plan and do not write to GitHub.
